title: Stop trying to be enough…
paragraphs:
Stop trying to be enough…
Because the truth is: you never had to be.
God already IS — your strength, your peace, your covering, your foundation.
Surrender isn’t weakness… it’s the moment grace finally gets room to work.
If this hits you today, it’s not an accident. ❤️‍🔥✨

“My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is made perfect in weakness.”
— 2 Corinthians 12:9 (NIV)
